title: FEM: expose local contact stress and slip/state outputs through the stock workflow
description:
## Required native capability

Expose a built-in FreeCAD request/import/inspection path for actual local CalculiX penalty-contact stress and relative-displacement/state quantities, sufficient to assess compression, opening and stick/slip for each actual selected foundation-base interface and retained output increment. Prefer any applicable existing stock operation if identified; do not create a project-side contact-recovery engine.

## Evidence and observed coverage

Discovered while resolving onobumba/oomakhi bead oomakhi-q9f.12.7, R56. Current installed app is /Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app, last native verified +233/4eb8f43362c0cbc5a0dab4869ad77be6f27ad679. This is read-only installed-source/manual coverage evidence, not a newly executed solver failure or regression. Installed write_step_output.py emits per-contact *CONTACT PRINT with CF,CFN,CFS only (SHA8f928b2ebf6f24a00b9e6cb2af04dcfb7de419e5d1a3a5b8b364707a60b3183a). Inspected stock FRD/DAT import and mechanical-result paths expose no local CSTR/CDIS/contact-state route. Native ForceAccounting supplies equilibrium resultants; saved ContactObservation supplies original-reference owner-specific XYZ displacement samples and explicitly is not CDIS. Those existing features retain their accepted purposes.

Official CalculiX2.23 manual (Guido Dhondt, https://www.dhondt.de/ccx_2.23.pdf) §7.23 pp440–441 distinguishes CSTR/CDIS at active slave nodes/face integration points from CF/CFN/CFS surface totals. Contact theory pp238–239 and face-to-face pp242–244, plus friction §7.64 p519, distinguish elastic/sticking and sliding behaviour. Underlying solver output capability therefore exists; manual deck edits or a project-side new reader/mechanical recovery are forbidden by this user's built-in-only rule.

## Why the whole-house method needs this

The selected declared benchmark method is drained constant-E/small-strain soil increments from an equilibrated post-excavation reference. Its new concrete-soil interfaces initially have no contact traction. Existing substrate has real physical density/background stress; zero ADDED soil gravity is a separate incremental operator, not massless physical soil. To use one-step load-case results as the relevant G-to-wind/time-zero-fire support response without transferred friction history, the method must establish its actual full-compression/local-stick domain, or use a separately applicable complete history method. Global H/V<=0.15 and balanced body/pair resultants do not establish local sticking or compression for the actual flexible irregular foundation network and two separate pads. A local lightly compressed patch may slip even when the total ratio is small. No generic fixed/rough/frictionless base, scalar Winkler conversion or new tolerances may replace this duty.

This is a specific missing stock output/inspection capability for an independently reviewed conditional method. It is not a claim that every FreeCAD soil method requires initial stress/staging, a hot-system simulation or this particular feature. A complete applicable checked support input remains a permitted alternative. Fixing output exposure will not establish engineering accuracy, valid mesh/contact/material/history applicability or complete the house.

## Existing issue boundaries and reproduction

FreeCAD-927 supplied owner-specific displacement at declared physical points for nonconformal contact, explicitly not native local CDIS/CSTR/history; do not reopen it or replace that API. FreeCAD-9zt/V3 physical equilibrium outputs also have a different scope. The current missing request/import path can be inspected in installed writer/result interfaces; no new runtime reproducer/solve was executed. A separate source session should qualify actual native active/open/stick/slip examples through ordinary FreeCAD author/write/solve/import and cold lifecycle, preserving owners/coordinates/units/time identities. No implementation is authorized in this reporting session.

## Durable evidence

Repository https://github.com/onobumba/oomakhi.git, paths under artifacts/Fire-Access-Integration/r01/review/en2-complete-r01/house-configuration-ground-method-r56:
- installed-local-contact-output-coverage.json SHAea06291b49618bab818fe51cb883ca61ad21e825a030409ac53b71392514db51
- ground-support-method.json (final file to be pinned by source-routing receipt)
- independent-configuration-method-review.json (final reviewed requirement and applicability)
Previous R55 complete source/native inventory remains preserved. All original1%force/original-origin moment/paired-cut limits and5%sensitivity remain. R49/R51 failed results remain failed. No native operation, model/drawing change, mesh, writer or solve occurred in R56.
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate a supported built-in route to request and inspect actual local contact traction and relative-motion/state quantities for selected independently owned contact interfaces, with native slave/master/source element or integration-point identity, local frame/sign, units, output time/increment and active/open availability semantics. Preserve pair resultants, owner-specific point-U observation and V3 equilibrium contracts. Missing/inactive/ambiguous data must not be zero-filled as a successful state. Bind outputs to current actual model/mesh/solver/request/files and withdraw stale results after edits/reruns/cold reopening. Qualify with stock native contact examples and independent review; protect existing features. No project-side deck edits/recovery or changed1%/5%engineering limits. Software feature acceptance does not qualify the actual house, contact/history domain or design. Prefer an evidenced existing operation over unnecessary new machinery.

title: Native BIM/TechDraw door swing SVG selects the wrong circle centre
description:
Observed native output defect: both stock SA4-A802 one-way hinged-door plan symbols curve around the opposite corner instead of the actual hinge. Evidence comes from FreeCAD TechDrawGui.exportPageAsPdf after public BIM SectionPlane/DrawViewArch refresh, not a custom drawing producer.

Tested runtime: /Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app, FreeCAD27.1.0dev 49114+121, build93340a47b4c1f79b2ac32b704e45e5a21706b72c. Oomakhi source revision352474cf, originating building issue oomakhi-q9f.12.4. Exact native SVG observations are siblings native-svg/SA4_A802_D01_whole_arrival_plan.svg SHAd81f8ccad8652db593fb1ce55859f004c3611e1a581a39eefd5ac2e4139b206f, D09 SHAe17b2102a99ab57beea3895cef320f2fe2d7665fa6e12bd9b8ac602880b14226. All paths belong to /Users/zukomgwili/src/oomakhi, not this source repository.

Expected: Window/Window008, native Mode1 (Arc90), Opening100, SymbolPlantrue; Section024/027 OnlySolidstrue; native plan circle centred at hinge. D01 hinge=(14310,940), closed tip=(14310,1787), open tip=(13463,940). D09 hinge=(14310,8540), tips=(14310,9387)/(13463,8540). Native radius847mm. Coordinates before common scale(1,-1).

Observed: both exported paths have A847 847 0 0 0. W3C SVG endpoint-to-centre conversion selects (13463,1787)/(13463,9387), not the hinges. Error847*sqrt(2)=1197.83888733mm. Curve midpoint is350.83888733mm from hinge, rather than847mm. PDF shows wrong concavity and tangency parallel to leaf at tip. R22 isolated each erroneous dedicated native symbol from a duplicate general-projection symbol. Oomakhi review/check falsely accepted it because they copied expected sweep=0 and never reconstructed arc centre. That separate acceptance defect remains with Oomakhi; filing this issue does not fix or accept the drawing.

Source inspection: installed BIM/ArchWindow.py Mode1 creates Part.Arc through p, rotated45 and rotated90 about v1, then LineSegment(v3,v1). BIM/ArchSectionPlane.py getSVG dedicated window-symbol branch passes that compound to Draft.get_svg. Draft/draftfunctions/svgshapes.py circle-arc converter derives flag_sweep using DraftVecUtils.angle(t1,t2,drawing_plane_normal)<0. Suspected sign/projection/orientation handling in that native SVG path; the exact runtime edge-centre/tangent getter and a minimal independent stock reproducer are NOT yet executed. Do not claim that source line is conclusively the sole cause. A source session should check rotated planes, reversed topological orientation and clockwise/counterclockwise arcs against actual projected centres.

Reproduction with retained benchmark: cold-open saved model; confirm both OnlySolids controls and native window operation; stock ShowDrawing/RedrawPage; export SA4_A802 through TechDrawGui.exportPageAsPdf; compare visible arc centre with hinge/leaf junction. No crash occurred. No verified stock workaround or source fix has been applied. Do not edit SVG/PDF; source repair belongs to separate session per user instruction.

Acceptance: stock native exported arcs preserve projected underlying centre, radius and sweep for both clockwise/counterclockwise, transformed drawing planes and reversed edges; regression rejects an arc with correct radius/endpoints but wrong centre. Re-export both affected benchmark doors and inspect actual PDF. Existing raw evidence and Oomakhi acceptance/rejection history preserved.
notes:
2026-10-13 completion evidence:
- Reproduced before implementation inspection with installed /Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app: minimal radius-847 quarter arc emitted sweep=0, reconstructing centre (-847,847) instead of (0,0), error 1197.83888733 mm.
- Root cause: the fallback SVG path derived sweep from a 3D tangent-angle sign rather than the emitted projected coordinates, and ignored vertex traversal reversals introduced while joining paths.
- Fix: derive sweep from the projected radial/tangent cross product at the actual emitted start; use the reverse endpoint tangent when traversal begins at LastParameter. Applies consistently to circles and ellipses.
- Regression coverage: independent W3C endpoint-to-centre oracle; 160 circle combinations spanning clockwise/counter-clockwise, minor/semicircle/major arcs, five 3D plane transforms, opposite normals, and TechDraw mode; forced reversed-emission circle; rotated ellipse forward/reverse; retained compact-circle and island tests.
- Verification: focused Draft SVG suite 7/7; full TestDraft 90/90; flake8 (documented 100-column command) clean; git diff --check clean. Independent subagent review reported no remaining actionable defects.
- Final retained-model stock Show Drawing/RedrawPage/TechDrawGui.exportPageAsPdf route produced A1 PDF SHA256 a6dafaa6216e33e624d162494260ee1317b4c57c29a8a3fb8dd61e0fdd7e58e3. D01 native SVG SHA256 888c2c9e64f7f7287c702d28cd469fd152ad1f0416d6b233e4fac3eb63001832 reconstructs centre (14310,940), error 0. D09 SVG SHA256 5965f552988d0ced1e7c9cf0483ea0f5b9a9af4898f3ad19fb9100d3a147fd reconstructs centre (14310.000000000002,8539.999999999998), error 2.57e-12 mm. Full-page and close-detail render inspection show both swings meeting the hinge and leaf endpoints. Retained model SHA256 remains 37d02b763540aeb0a75986f7e60c06ff65bf8fd970482ecf9a161c1846239add; exporter reports model unchanged and document closed.
- Follow-up FreeCAD-mhb records the separate OCC 8.x projectToSVG version-gate defect discovered during diagnosis.

comments.author: Zuko Mgwili
comments.text: Reproduced before source inspection using a clean isolated profile: a Qt event filter emitted the same warning while Gui::NotificationLabel was shown, and stock FreeCAD plus the pre-fix source build blocked in mutexNotification re-entry. title: Base: extensionless files under dotted directories produce misplaced timestamp backups

# FEM rigid-region node lookup conflates independently meshed coincident faces

Origin: Oomakhi `oomakhi-q9f.12.7`. Investigate/fix in the FreeCAD source repository in a separate session. This session changes no FreeCAD implementation, mesh node sets or solver decks.

## Installed scope and reproduction

Installed `/Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app`, 27.1.0dev49114+170, compiled commit `63a753404a7ede248606b64250e85e34bbafc943`. Source HEAD at inspection is7546dd96e19a585f0651535803452fd64095e9dc (later metadata). Run the exact independently admitted `native_port_regions.py` under installed FreeCADCmd with its isolated `port-region-user.cfg`/`port-region-system.cfg`. The macro copies the saved original ownership witness to an exclusive owned working file before opening. It retains the same two native touching100×80mm footprint boxes and separate RBE face references. Native Gmsh is configured BEFORE the only mesh with `CoherenceMesh=False` for the intended nonbonded bodies, `AnalysisGroupMeshing=True`, second-order elements, max40/min20mm. Both native RBE reference positions are explicitly the same force point. One native j97 scalar Y connector uses1000N/mm solely as a software input. No material, load, solver, physical rigid-patch or building design is supplied or accepted.

Use real Gmsh from the existing Pixi environment. The stage caps the invocation at180seconds and preserves native BREP/geo/VTK, all raw generated groups, both native region resolver returns/errors, saved FCStd and JSON. No hand-created mesh or corrected group is involved.

## Observed result and independent topology check

Gmsh exits normally0, producing881nodes/401volumes/308faces/56groups. Native Face2 andFace7 each contain18 distinct face elements. Generated RBERC andRBELedger groups correspond to these respective face-element groups, with type `All` and exact object names.

Standard VTK-reader inspection independently establishes47 mesh-node IDs per receiving face, with EMPTY intersection. The interface has genuinely separate coincident nodes; it was not welded by an accidental coherence setting. The union has94nodes.

Yet both existing native calls return that SAME94-node union for each body:

- `meshtools.get_femnodes_by_femobj_with_references` (ordinary RBE writer path);
- `elastic_connector.rigid_body_nodes` (new native port validator).

The native `resolve_connector` correctly rejects the wrongly resolved sets with `Rigid Body connector regions must not overlap.` This is not the documented rejection of genuinely shared regions; raw native face connectivity proves these intended regions are disjoint.

The retained `port-region-result.json` records `passed:false`, complete native groups/sets and baseline unchanged. `meshtools.get_femmesh_groupdata_sets_by_name` seeks a group starting `<RBEname>_` with type `Node`, while the stock Gmsh analysis groups here have exact RBE names and type `All` containing face-element IDs. The ordinary getter falls back to coordinate-based `getNodesByFace`, which selects both independent owners. The j97 validator directly uses the same geometric reference lookup. Preserve native CAD/group ownership consistently through BOTH resolver paths; do not disable the real-overlap guard.

The outer log also contains a secondary FileExists warning naming the macro's exclusive working directory. Its trigger is unverified; see `execution-warning-evidence.json`. Only one supervised command is recorded; the exclusive guard would stop an additional entry before another model/mesh operation. No claim of one clean invocation, Qt causation or separate confirmed native defect is made. The independent raw topology and retained native API results establish the owner-conflation finding without relying on that diagnosis.

This blocks admitting the proposed coincident receiving-patch/native-port route before a house analysis. It does not establish physical joint failure or impossibility of all FreeCAD/CalculiX methods. Noncoincident receiving regions would require their own physically justified complete method, not moving geometry to rescue this test. Keep genuine-overlap and noncollinearity guards. No hand-filtered project node sets or cached IDs are an acceptable production workaround. title: FEM mesh groups collapse independent coincident face references to the first face
description:
# Native FEM coincident-face group correspondence loses owner identity

Origin: Oomakhi `oomakhi-q9f.12.7`; report/fix belongs to the FreeCAD source repository, separate session. No FreeCAD source changes or workaround were made here.

## Tested build and expected behaviour

Installed `/Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app`, 27.1.0dev49114+150, compiled commit `0c0815199389bf6232e1c521489bf5c888ea03f3`. The witness imports Part, ObjectsFem, meshtools and geomtools only from the installed application; exact paths are retained in `face-ownership-result.json`. Source checkout HEAD at inspection is `df864e9929e6231d932113423043a7f79c3311e4`, distinct from compiled metadata.

Two independently owned coincident faces selected for separate native RigidBody References should map to their respective compound subfaces. Geometric equality alone must not silently replace the second owner with the first. Ambiguity in genuinely external geometric references should be diagnosed rather than guessed.

## Minimal native reproduction

All evidence below is in the Oomakhi repository, under `artifacts/Fire-Access-Integration/r01/review/en2-complete-r01/native-fem-features-r25/`.

Run the retained `native_face_ownership_witness.py` in installed FreeCADCmd with isolated user/system configuration. It uses two standard Part::Box objects and a Part::Compound, plus two stock ObjectsFem.makeConstraintRigidBody objects. The boxes have positive180/95mm depths on opposite sides of X62.5 and the same100Y×80Z footprint. Those dimensions illustrate one proposed ledger washer footprint; the boxes are a mapping witness, not a physical connection model or an accepted joint idealization.

The native receiving references are `RCFootprint.Face2` and `LedgerFootprint.Face1`. Both centres are `(62.5,2843,5835)`mm and both areas8000mm2. Native `isSame` and `isPartner` are false; stock `is_same_geometry` is true. Calling unmodified `meshtools.get_reference_group_elements` for each constraint returns:

```
RBERC      -> Face2
RBELedger  -> Face2
```

Expected: distinct compound face indices preserving the two native owners. Observed: first geometrically equal face selected for both. The witness reports `native_mapping_pass:false`, saves `native-faying-face-witness.FCStd`, and raises the expected assertion. FreeCADCmd still returns0 for that caught script exception; the execution receipt is transport completion, not semantic acceptance. Observed once in this bounded installed invocation; no repeat-frequency or regression claim.

Native command1.121823s, entire supervised stage5.969492s, event2178, receipt `441ab4b9e3223dea211661e54717ce20d19b7d1915a334ef985e5f8822137acc`. Log: `artifacts/Section-Integration/r01/execution-state/70bec3951e60987a85ac1e2057722ebea974d4338f7ba18600e832af063191ad.log`.

## Source path and limits

Installed `femmesh/meshtools.py:get_reference_group_elements` obtains each owner subobject then calls `geomtools.find_element_in_shape`. The latter returns the first face passing `is_same_geometry`; that predicate compares centre/vertices rather than identity/owner. Even named analysis mesh groups call this correspondence helper. Raw geometric node fallback is also insufficient for distinct coincident owners; this witness does not execute that fallback or meshing.

No Gmsh, CalculiX, loading, house import or node-set repair was performed. No wrong solver forces or automatic tie are claimed as observed. This is a demonstrated correspondence failure at the existing native pre-meshing API. It blocks admitting the proposed coincident receiving-patch route, not all FreeCAD/CalculiX analysis or every structural arrangement. Own-force-line reference ports remain a distinct possible method where their receiving regions can be represented and justified.

The installed n1h orthotropic and ctq concentrated translational features separately pass47 installed tests/29 real solves. This report does not reopen them. Related feature `FreeCAD-j97` addresses broader explicit region coupling/rotational qualification; this existing group-correspondence defect is narrower and independently reproducible. Physical load-introduction, stiffness inputs and whole normal/R30 design remain separate Oomakhi obligations.

## Acceptance for source session

Preserve exact native subshape identity/ownership in reference-to-compound correspondence, handle opposite orientations and explicit compound FaceN references, and reject unresolved external geometric ambiguity. Add native regression evidence for independently owned coincident faces and distinct noncoincident controls. Verify applicable analysis/mesh-group generation, save/reopen and regeneration; retain existing valid geometric-reference use cases. No hand-filtered node groups, changed house geometry or source-issue closure alone can accept the Oomakhi method.

title: Qualify graphics readiness and cleanup in batch page printing
description: Discovered during FreeCAD-d0u source investigation. PagePrinter::preRenderSetUp obtains a graphics template then dereferences it without validating it; postRenderCleanUp also dereferences it. The helper is called by print, printAll and printAllPdf as well as printPdf. A fresh never-shown DrawPage has an eagerly created QGSPage but no graphics template until initialized; native direct export was reproduced crashing on that null. The d0u fix checks required graphics before the single-page PDF writer opens its destination, preserving already initialized scenes even without an open/foreground tab. The other print/batch callers do not yet have the same readiness check. Their null path is source-predicted, NOT independently reproduced through the native print/batch UI. Qualify the actual commands and exception/error handling before patching: prevent crashes and partial/truncated output for uninitialized pages, retain valid initialized printing, and decide whether failure or documented initialization is appropriate. Review exception-safe exportingPdf flag/document-state restoration if the template update or rendering fails. Do not claim all hidden pages are unsupported; initialized closed-tab scenes remain exportable. Source: src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/PagePrinter.cpp print/printAll/printAllPdf and shared preRenderSetUp/postRenderCleanUp. Separate from the completed single-page API guard and dialog-focus issue FreeCAD-pa9.
notes:
Independent source review also identified an adjacent unsafe template subtype assumption: preRenderSetUp/postRenderCleanUp carry QGISVGTemplate* via static_cast even though QGSPage::setPageTemplate also creates QGIDrawingTemplate for DrawParametricTemplate. Only virtual updateView is needed, so a general QGITemplate* is the likely safe seam. This parametric-template case is source-predicted and was not independently GUI-reproduced in d0u. Qualify it with the batch-readiness/error-cleanup cases; do not describe it as fixed by the single-page pre-writer guard.

title: Guard PDF API export of a page without a shown GUI tab
description: During FreeCAD-y4h native GUI reproduction, a recomputed disposable DrawPage/DrawViewArch/template was exported with TechDrawGui.exportPageAsPdf before any page tab had been shown. FreeCAD exited on SIGSEGV / KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS 0x0, leaving a zero-byte PDF. Crash report: /Users/zukomgwili/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/FreeCAD-2026-10-13-182738.ips; main-thread stack TechDrawGui::PagePrinter::printPdf(ViewProviderPage*,...) +904 then TechDrawGui::Module::exportPageAsPdf +316. Source-build runtime dev49114+129 on macOS/Qt6.11.2. Showing the page tab and settling GUI events makes the same export succeed. This is separate from y4h text placement and FreeCAD-pa9 save-dialog focus. Direct API takes page/path; existing export macros show the page first. History 797c1180 describes guarding nonexistent/hidden export tabs, so an unshown tab may be unsupported; the requested behavior is a safe exception or explicit guard instead of a native crash, not an assertion that all unshown pages must be exportable. Preserve existing nonforeground shown-page exports. Diagnostic prototype is /private/tmp/freecad-y4h.uCQUsc/FreeCADY4hRepro.py (now corrected to show page), original crash report retained; current successful PDFs are disposable.
notes:
Completed 2026-10-13. Claimed and reproduced in isolated native source GUI BEFORE reading implementation: valid recomputed DrawPage/SVG template, no shown tab, direct TechDrawGui.exportPageAsPdf. Exit139/SIGSEGV and zero-byte output were reproduced with an annotation, without any drawing views, and after GUI-event settling. Current crash report FreeCAD-2026-10-13-214250.ips points to PagePrinter::printPdf +904; diagnostic scripts/logs retained under /private/tmp/freecad-d0u.r6PP6B. Ranked hypotheses distinguished missing graphics, pending initialization and wrong foreground page.

Root cause: ViewProviderPage eagerly owns QGSPage, but a fresh page has no rendered template item until initialized. Shared preRenderSetUp dereferenced that null template after QPdfWriter had already opened/truncated the destination. The narrow single-page fix preflights actual view-provider/scene/template assets in PagePrinter::printPdf BEFORE writer construction or screen/export-state mutation and throws Base::RuntimeError, mapped by the public binding to Python RuntimeError with a show-page instruction. It does NOT require an active/open/foreground tab and does not silently create one. Added public API docstring guidance. Initialized scenes continue exporting after show/hide, and exports target the requested page when another page is foreground.

Four permanent native GUI tests in new shipped TDTest.DrawPageExportTest, registered in TestTechDrawGui and TDTest_SRCS: fresh uninitialized page raises with no output; existing destination sentinel remains byte-identical; inactive target exports a complete PDF with its own page title; previously shown/closed-tab scene exports successfully. Error tests assert GUI modified/visibility/ScreenMode state and tab count are unchanged. New tests crashed on the unpatched native module; focused4 now pass in1.035s and original feedback loop passes with RuntimeError in0.063s. Uses timer-free GUI/deferred-delete processing: an early diagnostic QTimer.singleShot helper caused a separate Shiboken teardown abort after successful exports; removing that helper makes the baseline/fixed controls exit0. No additional FreeCAD teardown bug is asserted.

Quality gates: TechDrawGui, TechDraw_Data and TDTestTarget built with warnings-as-errors; native TestTechDrawGui15/15 and command TestTechDrawApp14/14 pass. Successful nonforeground and initialized-tabless red/green PDFs render byte-identical PNGs at1800px (all four SHA256 081ca6667c9b10a0a17ba416be49535febdde57a68c57d6f8f9d09598a8c5a87); intended-only text extraction and visual inspection confirmed page identity. title: IFC rebar export post-composes global placement and misplaces rotated local offsets
description: Discovered during FreeCAD-6n1 centreline/solid placement validation. The only in-tree getRebarData consumer, src/Mod/BIM/importers/exportIFC.py around line2139, assigns w.Placement = w.Placement.multiply(obj.getGlobalPlacement()) before scaling and creating an IfcSweptDiskSolid. For object-local rebar wires, this post-composes the global transform: a local transverse offset is not rotated by the owning object. A stock detached diagnostic using that exact consumer expression shows a 0.518156334mm centre error against the actual solid for a hosted straight-X bar, DirectionY, Distance2, OffsetStart1 (the preexisting matching-placement control), diameter12, object translation(70,-20,30) and rotation37deg about(1,1,1). Executing the unmodified ArchRebar getter pinned at commit49ca055b92 produces exactly the same centre/error as the current FreeCAD-6n1 getter, establishing this transform-order symptom predates the placement fix. Left-composition obj.getGlobalPlacement().multiply(w.Placement) reduces the error to 3.18e-14mm. Native FreeCADCmd probe /private/tmp/freecad-6n1.1tZ6Zb/FreeCAD6n1IFCPlacementProbe.py and ifc-transform-order.log retained. This diagnostic replays the stock transform expression; an actual written/reimported IFC geometric qualification remains outstanding. No original building files or IFC consumer code were changed. Acceptance: reproduce actual stock IFC output and compare imported IfcSweptDiskSolid centreline/solid coordinates for nonidentity bar rotations/translations and parent global placements; select correct object-local/global transform composition without double transforms; preserve identity-placement output, units/radius, multiple/custom-spacing placements and fresh-copy ownership; add an exporter regression.
notes:
Completed implementation and validation pending final landing. Reproduced actual stock written IFC before further exporter implementation inspection, not only the expression replay inherited from FreeCAD-6n1: original hosted straight bar with DirectionY Distance2 OffsetStart1 and owner rotation37deg about(1,1,1), translation(70,-20,30), had0.518156334mm IFC-world-mesh centre error versus native solid in both FreeCADCmd and actual native source GUI; unrotated translated control agreed~3e-14mm and swept radius was0.006m. Minimized to one unhosted straight0..160mm wire, DirectionY OffsetStart1, ownerRz90, with no host, span override or translation: actual IFC centre(0,81,0) versus native(-1,80,0), error sqrt2mm. Root cause confirmed incorrect local/global placement order: object-local wire transform W was applied after global owner G (W*G) instead of G*W; this branch stores world-coordinate directrices and an identity IFC product placement. Cached G once and left-composed it with each fresh wire, leaving radius/unit scale/order, getter, IFC product placement, generated solids and ownership unchanged. Added three optional-IfcOpenShell actual export/reopen regressions in already registered TestArchRebar, no CMake/registration changes. Matrix16 variants covers hosted/unhosted single bars, identity/translation/Rz90/noncommuting rotations in metre/foot units; separate tests cover multiple/uniform/nonuniform CustomSpacing with transformed base+host and two nested App::Part ancestors. Oracle compares every parsed SweptDiskSolid directrix endpoint against independent native planar end-cap centroids; checks exact file scale/radius, declared unit scale and identity product placement; independently reconstructs whole IFC product world mesh; verifies source Base/solid BREP, PlacementList and native cache BREP are unmodified. New class ran red before fix:19 tests,11 failing cases. Now19 core plus both original feedback loops=21 CLI pass; original rotated error~7e-15mm, minimal~8.7e-16mm. Full TestArch passes323 in CLI, native GUI323 plus original2=325, both with one existing expected failure. Optional dependency guard was tested in an isolated import harness:19 tests pass16 and skip only3 IFC methods without changing installed dependencies. BIM Python resources rebuilt and both changed source/build copies have matching SHA256. Black and git diff checks clean; regression file Flake8 clean; exporter has exactly the same48 diagnostic texts as HEAD baseline, no new lint findings. No production debug instrumentation. Diagnostic prototypes, written IFCs and red/green logs retained in /private/tmp/freecad-76o.SR2Xyi. Original building models and installed app unchanged. One independent final review approved; second pending.
Both independent final reviews approved with no blockers, including a reviewer BIM suite run. Committed as 8c7ef26904.

title: Raw-solid SVG export returns blank for an axis-aligned box in default projection
description: Discovered while adding FreeCAD-7do raw-shape style tests. Stock shape=Part.makeBox(10,7,3); Draft.get_svg(shape, color="#123456") returns no paths with default direction=None, while explicit oblique direction App.Vector(1,2,3) yields paths. Reproduced independently in FreeCADCmd, which never enters GUI print-color lookup; supplied color also bypasses that lookup in GUI, so this geometry symptom is separate from the FreeCAD-7do metadata failure and its guard. Exact diagnostic /private/tmp/freecad-7do.cRd4xR/FreeCAD7doBoxProbe.py and box-cli.log: one default-projection subtest fails, oblique control passes. Candidate source behavior, not a final diagnosis: svgshapes.get_path iterates projected edge groups and returns an empty string if any group matches previous pathdata, potentially discarding already accumulated path output for coincident box projections. Acceptance: establish intended raw-solid default/axial projection contract, minimize repeated projected paths, preserve nonduplicate geometry and styles, and add GUI/command regression tests for boxes and other multi-group shapes. No geometry-export change is included in FreeCAD-7do.
notes: Reproduced in both FreeCADCmd and the actual native source GUI before changing implementation: default raw Part.makeBox(10,7,3) export was blank while an oblique control worked; minimized to two disconnected Z-separated lines with identical XY projections. Root cause: get_path returned from the entire call upon finding one exact duplicate group, discarding already assembled unique geometry and preventing later groups from being processed. Changed suppression to skip only the duplicate group, retaining the exact serialized shared-ledger contract and returning no SVG when no unique groups remain; circle/ellipse direct-SVG behavior is unchanged. Added four permanent regressions covering all duplicate-first/middle/last permutations with and without a preseeded ledger, all-cached and empty-input behavior without cache mutation, the public raw compound path, and default/positive/negative axial plus oblique box projections across fill and TechDraw modes. Tests assert exact projected linear segment sets, no duplicate serialized subpaths, preserved stroke/fill/dash/opacity/scale styling, and unchanged source BREP. New regression class ran red before the fix (21 tests with 42 failures and one GUI-only skip), then green (21 tests with one GUI-only skip); original minimized CLI/native GUI feedback loop is green. Draft resources rebuilt and both changed source/build copies have matching SHA256 hashes. Full TestDraft passes 110 in native GUI and 110 in CLI with three GUI-only skips; TestDraftGui passes 65; full TestArch passes 312 with one existing expected failure; native ArchSectionPlane/TechDrawApp passes 28. Black, flake8 and git diff checks pass. Diagnostic modules and red/green logs retained in /private/tmp/freecad-zeo.zSKIym. Existing installed app and building models were not modified. Two independent final reviews approved with no blockers, including caller audits for the deliberate empty-input suppression. Committed as 49ca055b92.

title: Coordinate FreeCADCmd shutdown with showMainWindow(True) GUI thread
description: FreeCAD-jrt moves Python-backed workbench-manipulator cleanup ahead of interpreter finalization. FreeCADGui.showMainWindow(True) starts GUI initialization in a detached thread, so command-process shutdown can overlap StartupProcess/workbench manipulator activity (and broader Python/Qt GUI activity). Establish supported threaded-lazy-GUI lifecycle semantics, synchronization/join or shutdown signaling, and regression coverage. Do not treat the normal showMainWindow() FreeCAD-jrt path as unresolved.
notes: Fixed by removing detached Qt startup and explicitly defining safe legacy-flag contract: showMainWindow(True) with no QApplication now raises RuntimeError before allocating Qt/GUI state, advising main-thread showMainWindow(); with existing QApplication True remains synchronous. Existing QApplication calls from non-owner threads are rejected before widgets mutate. Native red repro immediate old True startup exit0 then SIGSEGV(-11) with QApplication-not-main-thread warning. Qt widgets/event loop require main thread (https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/threads-qobject.html); joining unsupported off-main widget startup would not suffice. Four lifecycle process cases written and observed red before fix, now pass: sync, repeated immediate rejection, rejection->valid sync recovery, host-owned QApplication. Each GUI case also checks worker-thread rejection. Existing GuiShutdown regression green. notes: Completed 2026-10-13: reproduced twice in the native source GUI before reading the implementation, with a disposable stock DraftLabel, Arch section, real TechDraw page/template and ordinary exportPageAsPdf. title: Investigate rotated DraftLabel section SVG leader crossing own text
description:
Observed native DraftLabel leader/text collision in rotated Arch section PDFs

Origin: Oomakhi oomakhi-q9f.10, complete ordinary structural benchmark drawings. Tested installed FreeCAD-27.1.0, source commit 93340a47, macOS. This report requests separate source investigation; it does not authorize a patch or close building delivery.

Actual files:
- /Users/zukomgwili/src/oomakhi/artifacts/Structural-Integration/r02/drawing/SA3-final-note-correction/SA3-S301.pdf
- /Users/zukomgwili/src/oomakhi/artifacts/Structural-Integration/r02/drawing/SA3-final-note-correction/SA3-S501.pdf
- Enlarged actual output: /Users/zukomgwili/src/oomakhi/artifacts/Structural-Integration/r02/review/SA3-final-notes-S301-labelcrop.png and SA3-final-notes-S501-labelcrop.png.

Saved ordinary DraftLabel objects have horizontal StraightDirection, native label Placement quaternion approximately (0.5,-0.5,0.5,-0.5), actual model TargetPoint and material text. They are included in stock ArchSectionPlane.Objects; stock DrawViewArch Rotation90 with LineSpacing4 exports the native section. In the actual PDFs the material leaders run diagonally through their own first text lines. Both supported pairings (positive StraightDistance/Right justification and negative/Left) were observed to retain this collision. Native view-provider updateData/update_label enforces that pairing. The native 3D view's precise appearance was not independently inspected, so no claim of a verified GUI/PDF discrepancy is made.

Relevant source observations, not a proven final root cause:
- Mod/Draft/draftobjects/label.py execute constructs Points from Placement, Placement.multVec(StraightDistance,0,0) and TargetPoint.
- Mod/Draft/draftviewproviders/view_label.py updateData and update_label enforce justification/distance pairing and handle label text presentation.
- Mod/Draft/draftfunctions/svg.py label export (~788-848 in inspected source) exports obj.Points and text at Placement using Justification. It does not use the native TextAlignment/margin presentation control examined here.

Investigate projected text/leader clearance in rotated section SVG output, retaining built-in DraftLabel properties and comparing actual native view and ordinary TechDraw PDF. A minimal reproduction is still needed from these exact objects. Acceptance should cover both permitted sign/justification pairings and rotated section orientations, with readable text and a leader leaving its text rather than crossing it.

Separate authoring errors are NOT attributed to this report: an initial incorrect justification assumption, and a later stock TechDraw replacement that positioned new annotations before DrawPage.addView centred them. The latter is an Oomakhi ordering error with an existing-object property correction. A standard TechDraw Annotation/LeaderLine route is being qualified as a built-in alternative; this source report is not a current FreeCAD-blocker claim.
notes:
Completed source investigation and qualified fix on 2026-10-13. Native GUI reproduction was built and run before implementation reading, preserving the Oomakhi building files. The first mirrored outward-target control was clear in both current source and installed app; replaying dLabel025 target delta (-1485,-250,0) produced repeatable export-only collisions (+200/Right: 71 ink pixels, negative/Left: clear) while native World text was clear. Identity-plane reproduction remained red, and native Top/Bottom alignment changed while SVG stayed identical. Root cause: SVG Label export anchored its first baseline directly at Placement.Base, ignoring the native unframed World label margin and TextAlignment. This is not merely an old build and is distinct from 9mj text-normal suppression.

Fix: for World, Frame=None, noncenter labels, calculate the native deterministic horizontal margin and Top/Middle/Bottom first-baseline offset using the exported font size and absolute drawing line spacing; transform that local offset by the real label Rotation BEFORE projecting it. Leader Points, TargetPoint, Placement, justification/sign pairing and native scenegraph are untouched. Framed, Center and Screen behavior remains unchanged. No public API or dependency changes.

Two permanent regression methods in the already registered DraftSVGTextExportRegression class: 288 first-baseline/margin cases over six frames, parallel/opposite/45-degree oblique projections, both SVG modes, both canonical signs and all three vertical alignments, asserting no native geometry/scenegraph mutation; and four actual stock DrawViewArch raster-ink cases including exact dLabel025/S301 placement, target, section quaternion/base, .04 scale, FontSize6, LineSpacing4 and Rotation90. The final tests were replayed against pinned pre-fix svg.py from 8c7ef26904 in an isolated native process and went red; current source is green. Oblique testing proves first-baseline positioning, not broader multiline glyph/line-spacing projection, which is unchanged.

Fuller disposable replicas of all five stored labels were also compared in native 3D, SVG masks and ordinary TechDraw PDFs. The corrected 025 and031 Right/positive cases are clear. Positive/Right 026,027,029 still backtrack across text in BOTH native 3D and SVG: these are authored routing collisions, not the export baseline bug. Negative/Left controls are clear for ALL FIVE. A canonical pairing alone cannot guarantee clearance for every arbitrary target route; callers must place the elbow/anchor on the appropriate side or use supported custom leader points. No automatic rerouting or production-building correction/acceptance is claimed. All building files were read-only. Current diagnostic artifacts/scripts are in /private/tmp/freecad-y4h.uCQUsc; they are clearly separated from production.

Quality gates: Draft resource build succeeded; focused native class8 passed, TestDraft112 passed with five GUI-only skips, final TestDraftGui67 passed, native TestArch323 passed with one existing expected failure. Configured Black100, Flake8 (excluding pre-existing E266/E722 plus standard E203/W503), and git diff --check passed. Two independent final reviews approved; first-baseline wording and exact historical fixture recommendations addressed. Separate hidden-page PDF API SIGSEGV recorded as discovered-from FreeCAD-d0u; shown-page diagnostic export succeeds. /Applications installation was NOT changed.
close_reason: Corrected exported label margin and vertical first-baseline placement; regression verified, intrinsic authored backtracking routes distinguished and documented.

title: BIM single rebar centreline and solid use different placement rules
description:
Origin: Oomakhi oomakhi-q9f.10. Installed FreeCAD27.1.0dev49114+121/93340a47; installed ArchRebar.py SHA256 e90d2e62da7337c83a931e7faaae1bb0fc29a09ddcd041c0b4fdecb9b46592c2. Source inspection establishes two inconsistent single-bar placement rules: _Rebar.getRebarData lines291-296 with Amount1 and Host translates by Direction*Distance/2 (or half host extent); execute uses CalculatePlacement lines676-684, returning Direction*OffsetStart. Thus ordinary Amount1 default Distance0/OffsetStart0 reports a centred centreline but generates its solid at the unshifted path. This is a source-established inconsistency; a fresh actual GUI minimal Shape/getRebarData comparison remains outstanding and no crash is claimed. It is not currently established as a blocking bug.

title: DrawViewArch recompute depends on ambient active document instead of owning document
description:

Expected: recomputing an inactive owner uses that owner's source/view and does not fail or update an unrelated same-named object. Observed: wrong active owner lookup fails. title: Swept surface runtime registration bypasses GeomSweptSurface
description: Source-confirmed analogue discovered while fixing FreeCAD-d86. GeomSurfaceOfRevolution and GeomSurfaceOfExtrusion inherit GeomSweptSurface in Geometry.h, and GeomSweptSurface::isSame guards with isDerivedFrom<GeomSweptSurface>(). Their TYPESYSTEM_SOURCE registrations instead name GeomSurface as parent, while AppPart.cpp does not initialize the abstract GeomSweptSurface type. This can make inherited isSame reject identical swept surfaces. A prior FreeCAD-d86 comment records the same finding for SurfaceOfRevolution from Oomakhi R44, but no minimal runtime reproduction has yet been established. Reproduce both public types, correct registration and initialization, and add native/Python same/different regressions without conflating the SurfaceOfRevolution stub mismatch tracked by FreeCAD-wb3.
notes: Reproduced deterministically with FreeCADCmd through the public Python API: both Part.SurfaceOfExtrusion and Part.SurfaceOfRevolution reported isDerivedFrom('Part::GeomSweptSurface') == False and rejected self-comparison. Root cause was a split runtime hierarchy: both concrete C++ classes inherit GeomSweptSurface, but their TYPESYSTEM_SOURCE registrations named GeomSurface and AppPart never initialized the abstract swept type. Corrected the runtime parents and initialization. Once the base comparison became reachable, tests exposed two masked defects: extrusion and revolution could compare equal across concrete types, and revolution equality ignored the axis location. GeomSweptSurface::isSame now requires the same concrete runtime type, and GeomSurfaceOfRevolution::isSame compares point-to-axis-line distance while preserving equivalence for reference points shifted along the same axis. Added native and Python regressions covering ancestry, identical/self equality, basis and direction differences, linear/angular tolerance boundaries, revolution axis separation/equivalence, and cross-type rejection. Validation: Part and Part_tests_run rebuilt successfully (67 pre-existing OCCT deprecation warnings); all 335 native Part tests passed; all 302 registered TestPartApp tests passed; all 19 source RegressionTests passed; Python compile, Black, whitespace, and debug-marker checks passed. The original CLI repro now reports swept ancestry and self isSame as True for both public types.
close_reason: Fixed swept-surface runtime hierarchy and equality semantics with passing native/Python regressions

title: Installed FreeCADCmd cannot locate bundled libFreeCADApp without loader override
description: Observed 9 October 2026 in installed /Applications/FreeCAD-27.1.0.app (build 4d7b98067a6474f88e9f21c4cea75a34d7939dcf). title: BSplineSurface isSame compares V knots using U knot count
description:
Static source defect discovered during Oomakhi oomakhi-q9f.13 R44 preservation-observer review on 7 October 2026. Installed FreeCAD 27.1.0dev was compiled from 4d7b98067a6474f88e9f21c4cea75a34d7939dcf, Qt 6.11.2 / Python 3.13.15. The defect is present at that exact compiled source and current HEAD 92046d236cd54813bd65fd74ea8c9301baae3a74 in src/Mod/Part/App/Geometry.cpp:5418 (GeomBSplineSurface::isSame).

Expected: after verifying both surfaces have identical U/V knot counts, compare every V knot and V multiplicity using NbVKnots (vkc). Observed by source inspection: the V loop is for(Standard_Integer v=1; v<=ukc; ++v), using the U count. Separate ukc/vkc variables and count checks are already present. When vkc>ukc, trailing V knots/multiplicities are unexamined and isSame can accept unequal parameterization if remaining comparisons match. When ukc>vkc, the loop attempts an out-of-range VKnot/VMultiplicity access; exact runtime behavior is not reproduced or asserted.

Python stock Geometry.isSame(other,linearTol,angularTol) calls this C++ path via GeometryPyImp.cpp:216. No native runtime reproducer, app launch, source edit or source tests were performed by this reviewer. The finite building observer now also queries and compares full native getKnots/getUKnots/getVKnots arrays and full multiplicity arrays; this does not fix FreeCAD or permit a custom drawing method, and actual query errors still fail closed.

Durable static evidence in https://github.com/onobumba/oomakhi.git: artifacts/BIM-Transition/r44/review/continuation-route-bspline-source-evidence.json includes the exact 4d7 source method. Minimal stock reproduction remains to be authored in a separate source session: construct BSplineSurface pairs with unequal U/V knot counts and otherwise matched pole/weight/degree/status data, change only a trailing V knot or multiplicity while preserving a valid surface; prove false for unequal surfaces and true for identical surfaces. Also exercise U>V knot count without out-of-range access. No whole-building acceptance is claimed; original Oomakhi requirements remain open.
acceptance_criteria: In a separate source session, establish valid stock BSplineSurface pairs with unequal U/V knot counts; reproduce the skipped trailing V comparison and test U greater than V safely. Correct the V loop to cover its actual V count and add meaningful native regression tests for identical and unequal V knots/multiplicities. Verify Geometry.isSame Python behavior and preserve unrelated existing geometry/qualification evidence. Record runtime outcomes separately from this static source finding.
notes: Root cause confirmed at runtime: GeomBSplineSurface::isSame used ukc as the bound of its V-knot/V-multiplicity loop. With vkc > ukc it returned true after skipping trailing V data; with ukc > vkc it attempted out-of-range V access and surfaced a FreeCAD error. Fixed the loop bound to vkc. Added three native GTests and three Python Geometry.isSame regressions covering a trailing V-knot difference, trailing V-multiplicity differences, and identical surfaces where U has more knots than V. title: ArchWall and ArchStairs proxy state lose ArchSketch fields across dumps/loads
description:

Expected: both stock proxies preserve ArchSkPropSetPickedUuid and ArchSkPropSetListPrev through their own dumps/loads and saved FCStd cold-open/save round trips, retaining supported historical state compatibility.

Source evidence at HEAD fbde6e31784e15305ead282660370c142dce76d1:
- src/Mod/BIM/ArchComponent.py:427-431: Component.dumps returns None; Component.loads only sets Type.
- src/Mod/BIM/ArchWall.py:138: _Wall inherits Component directly. Lines 408-411 initialize UUID="" and previous-property-set list=[]. Lines 414-419 wrap the parent None as (None,) and append both fields, emitting (None, uuid, previous_property_sets). Lines 421-432 handle historical "Wall"-prefixed state correctly, but route current None-prefixed state to indices 0/1, assigning UUID=None and previous-property-set list=uuid while dropping the actual list.
- src/Mod/BIM/ArchStairs.py:61: _Stairs inherits Component directly. Lines 551-554 initialize the same fields. Lines 556-561 emit the same current tuple. Lines 563-574 route None-prefixed state to the same incorrect indices 0/1.

Source-level consequence: both default (None,"",[]) and nonempty (None,"selected-uuid",["Default","Variant"]) dumps states are decoded at the wrong positions. JSON converts these tuples to lists without changing that indexing. This follows from inspected code; it is not a claim of exercised native serialization or geometry corruption.

Compatibility scope: establish and preserve documented/supportable None, historical raw type-string, type-prefixed sequence, and legacy two-item UUID/list state formats; include UUIDs starting with W/S and matching Wall/Stairs where supported so type-marker dispatch does not silently lose fields.

title: Investigate empty closepath operations in native TechDraw PDFs
description:
Native TechDraw PDF exports retained during Oomakhi BIM drawing work contain empty closepath/fill operations and trigger Poppler "No current point in closepath" diagnostics. File as a bug with investigation scope: the observed output is evidenced; the responsible native child and FreeCAD-versus-Qt cause are unresolved.

Expected: ordinary TechDraw Export Page as PDF produces valid path operations without these parser diagnostics and preserves all visible drawing content.

Runtime evidence: exported PDF metadata identifies FreeCAD 27.1.0dev TechDraw and Qt 6.11.2. A retained FreeCAD 1.1.3/Qt 6.8.3 comparison has zero empty closepath/fill operations. The exact source commit used for each earlier export is not established by this report; current source inspection is at 85069f13d3edd995e84f354286c6226203644905. Version comparison alone does not isolate a Qt regression.

Observed: R30 A501 proof and an R31 hatch-hidden control each contain four bare h/f operations with no preceding path coordinates. The control does not establish a hatch cause. Later ordinary GUI TechDraw_ExportPagePDF exports also retain the diagnostics. No lost drawing ink has been demonstrated; visual acceptance and PDF syntax are separate checks.

Reproduction for the separate session: open the retained native page source identified by the evidence record, refresh it using stock FreeCAD controls, use ordinary TechDraw Export Page as PDF, then render/check with Poppler and inspect the reported content-stream paths. Preserve the exported bytes. Isolate the emitting native child and make a minimal document before proposing a fix. A minimal reproducer remains outstanding.

Evidence repository https://github.com/onobumba/oomakhi.git (available at commit 43423a05; local root /Users/zukomgwili/src/oomakhi):
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r30/pdf-warning-content-preflight.json pins comparison files, operator indices, hashes and parent view contexts.
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r30/gui-qualified/A501-hatch-proof.pdf SHA256 1c62fd7b2c7208b9398f78ab9b0caddad03f97f1298913314d20474d5854f63d.
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r31/diagnostics/A501-no-new-hatch.pdf SHA256 d719fe7f7656369656832514e44e14c0b8609b92824837964ae04e77ed91c325.
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r33/gui-final/A102.pdf SHA256 a2a1c68fe72161562eca2bec2ad2363059aff6f7b11b9e1106d4f77c5564fb0e; diagnostics at artifacts/BIM-Transition/r33/gui-final/A102-render.stderr and visual review at artifacts/BIM-Transition/r33/A102-independent-visual-review.json.
- Originating bead oomakhi-q9f.5.15 retains warning-free production qualification; source issue filing does not close it.

Source lead only: src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/QGIViewPart.cpp around line 425 constructs projected-edge painter paths without an emptiness check. This is not an isolated emitting path or proven cause. No source patch, PDF stream repair or custom renderer was applied. Source diagnosis/implementation is deferred to a separate session.
acceptance_criteria: Isolate the emitting native child/path and runtime conditions, establish FreeCAD versus Qt responsibility and retain a minimal stock reproducer. A supported stock export must be warning-free under the retained PDF checks and independently preserve visible drawing content. Do not claim a hatch cause or lost ink without evidence.
notes:
Resolved at source on codex/fix-techdraw-empty-pdf-paths, based on 239239de4f12b3c44767b1c11590fe972e6ccf32.

Isolated emitter: QGIViewDimension constructs a framed areaLeaderPointLabel for each dimension, including non-Area dimensions. Its QGIDatumLabel frame is a default QGraphicsRectItem with a null QRectF. With translucent NormalColor (0x000000D8), Qt PDF outlining emits a bare h f for this zero-size frame. Frame ancestry/transform matches the retained PDF operations. A minimal native box/view/Distance document emits one warning; hiding only its null frame before the same stock export removes it. A501 contains 159 nonempty projected QGIEdge paths, so the projected-edge source lead was not the cause. Area also retains a null frame; hiding only non-Area labels is insufficient.

Responsibility: an unmodified QGraphicsRectItem with null or translated-null rectangle, translucent pen and NoBrush reproduces in Qt 6.8.3 and 6.11.2. QPdf::Stroker::strokePath appends h f without checking that a coordinate was emitted (qtbase src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp:649-656 in both tags). This is not established as a Qt-version regression. A separate nonempty line wholly within a translucent dashed gap also exposes the Qt outline condition; qualification is tracked in FreeCAD-hii and no stock FreeCAD reproduction or missing ink is claimed for it.

Fix: route datum frames through existing QGCustomRect; return from paint only when rect().isNull(). Bounds, shapes, placement and datum interactions remain unchanged. One-axis zero dimensions and negative-sized rectangles remain paintable; isEmpty() would incorrectly suppress them.

Retained minimal stock reproducer: tests/src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/EmptyDimensionFrame.FCMacro, with optional Area. It restores changed preferences and uses physical widths before the stock Python PDF export, matching the ordinary GUI wrapper's ScreenMode=false. An initial diagnostic API export omitted that wrapper state and used oversized screen-scaled strokes; those fixtures were superseded by readable physical-mode red/green exports. No PDF stream repair or custom renderer was used.

Final native validation (Qt 6.11.2, Poppler 26.09.0): A501 bare closepaths/Poppler warnings 4/4 -> 0/0, A102 40/40 -> 0/0. Both controlled physical-mode renders are exactly RGB-identical at 2384x1684. Distance and theoretical-exact controls 1 -> 0; Area+exact and relocated Area+exact controls 2 -> 0; all four renders exactly RGB-identical at 842x595. Theoretical-exact nonnull frame and text remain visible; Area measures 100 mm2 and its relocated leader/text remain visible. Original FCStd sources and validation copies remain unchanged.

Final actual Gui.runCommand('TechDraw_ExportPagePDF') uses the stock MDI page and Export Page as PDF dialog, produces 0 bare closes/0 warnings with readable framed 10 mm dimension, and restores ScreenMode=true. Final committed manual macro with optional Area produces both PDFs with 0/0 diagnostics. All isolated native processes ended.

Quality gates: TechDrawGui and QGCustomRect_Tests_run build; recording-paint-engine QtTest compiles actual production source, fails both null cases before fix and passes after fix, while ordinary/horizontal/vertical/negative cases preserve rect, pen and brush. Final CTest target passes. Existing full TestTechDrawGui 11/11 and DimensionSuite 2/2 pass. Applicable pre-commit hooks, macro syntax and git diff --check pass. Independent source/test review found no actionable findings. Independent pypdf/Poppler/RGB/visual review approves readable geometry, text, hatch, dimensions, leader arrows and positive frame controls across all six pairs.

Scratch evidence: /tmp/freecad-k3b-native/validation (print-red/print-green and stock-command-print-final-green), /tmp/freecad-k3b-debug/final-independent-print-comparison.json, /tmp/freecad-k3b-ctest-final.log. Drawing-content regression acceptance only: no hatch cause or lost ink is claimed; Oomakhi production qualification bead oomakhi-q9f.5.15 remains separate and unchanged.
close_reason: Null datum-frame emitter isolated and fixed; stock PDF export is warning-free with independently preserved visible drawing content.

title: Clarify getVertexByIndex coordinate comments and public API convention

title: SurfaceOfRevolution stub misstates Location type and constructor argument order
description:
The stock Part.SurfaceOfRevolution Python stub contradicts its implemented public getter and constructor. Verified at exact installed-build source4d7b98067a6474f88e9f21c4cea75a34d7939dcf and current HEAD92046d236cd54813bd65fd74ea8c9301baae3a74 during Oomakhi oomakhi-q9f.13 R44 native-only geometry validation on7 October2026. No source fix or native app launch by this reviewer.

src/Mod/Part/App/SurfaceOfRevolution.pyi28 declares Location: Placement and its overload at38 declares (location: Placement, direction: Vector, basis_curve: GeometryCurve). Implemented SurfaceOfRevolutionPyImp.cpp93 getLocation returns a Vector built from the native gp_Pnt, and setLocation accepts Vector or tuple. PyInit at51 parses arguments in the different order (GeometryPy curve, Vector location, Vector direction). Therefore following the typed constructor signature supplies the wrong runtime types/order, and treating Location as a Placement uses an incorrect API contract. Actual root read-only native inventory of the six revolution faces per retained Pipe reported Location as Vector; runtime construction with the mistaken overload was not attempted.

Durable actual native inventory: https://github.com/onobumba/oomakhi.git artifacts/BIM-Transition/r44/recovery/native-pipe-curve-inventory.json SHAa9cd2c15e9c0867109e728d44341fa7f6292c021d81f9b84a6c0d260fbabdc44; actual supported observer uses native Location Vector and the exact runtime getters. This is separate from FreeCAD-d86 runtime type-registration/isSame behavior. No geometry or drawing acceptance follows from issue filing.
acceptance_criteria: Verify stock SurfaceOfRevolution constructor order and native Location getter/setter types in a separate source session. Correct the pyi Location annotation and constructor signature to match curve, location Vector, direction Vector; remove unused Placement import if appropriate. Add meaningful type/runtime contract coverage and verify the corrected example constructs a surface and exposes Vector Location without changing geometry behavior. Keep runtime isSame defects and Oomakhi package acceptance separate.
notes: Reproduced with a deterministic combined runtime/stub check. Runtime construction with Part.SurfaceOfRevolution(curve, Vector location, Vector direction) succeeded twice and Location returned a Vector, while the source stub failed because it declared Location as Placement and ordered the constructor as location, direction, basis_curve. Corrected Location to Vector, reordered the positional-only constructor to basis_curve, location, direction, and removed the unused Placement import. Added a binding-source AST regression that locks property type, parameter order/types, and positional-only semantics, plus a public runtime regression covering construction, Vector getter/setter behavior, and rejection of the old argument order.
